the_identity_trap_found_mid_audit.what_happened: a naive grep for '2026-09-07' in COORDINATION.md returned 413 hits and made 09-07 look as though it were all over the register. THE HITS WERE OVERWHELMINGLY TIMESTAMPS -- things DONE on 09-07, including the USER's own messages from that date -- not 09-07 DATA.
the_identity_trap_found_mid_audit.the_class: SEAT_PROTOCOL rule 16 -- verify at the artifact a claim names; grep hits on vocabulary are not references; match IDENTITY, and know what KIND of document you are reading.
the_identity_trap_found_mid_audit.why_it_is_filed_rather_than_noted: this is the EIGHTH appearance of this shape in this programme, and it caught a SEAT MID-AUDIT on the very question it was auditing. A careless count would have reported 'the day is thoroughly consumed' about a day nobody had looked at -- a FALSE POSITIVE, where the same shape has previously produced false all-clears.
the_identity_trap_found_mid_audit.the_operation_that_distinguishes_them: a DATE STRING in this register is a TIMESTAMP unless it appears as a day-key, a filename day segment, or beside a per-day quantity. The vocabulary is identical; the identity is not.
the_identity_trap_found_mid_audit.the_general_remedy: count what the hits ARE before counting how many there are.

day_is_in_the_ruled_set.note: 09-07 is not a bonus day found lying around; it is a ruled day the programme reserved, and settlement_endpoint.admissible_days is the switch that opens it.
